label: History-scaling control
title: When a history-scaling test is blind to dimension
summary: Gate 1 proved before execution that product-form ordered-axis Rule90 viewed through a coordinate slice has a history threshold set by one-dimensional ring algebra, not by the number of axes; independent implementations verify the frozen n=5/7 controls.
takeaway: For this declared law/observer pair, h_min(d,n)=D(n)-1 and is dimension-blind. This is a reusable experimental-design null, not evidence against history/dimension scaling under other representations.
